title: Dorsal determinant Hwa stabilizes beta-catenin through direct inhibition of GSK3.
authors: Ji, Lei; Chin, Chue Vin; Sun, Gangyu; Charlats, Olga; Vickers, Chad; Lu, Bo; Sigoillot, Frederic; Wang, Zhizhi; Xu, Wenqing; Cong, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Hwa蛋白通过磷酸化PPNSP基序抑制GSK3以稳定beta-catenin，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与MD模拟，但核心体系非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Stabilization of beta-catenin on the dorsal side of the embryo is critical for the formation of the dorsal organizer. The novel transmembrane protein Huluwa (Hwa) has recently been identified as the maternal dorsal determinant responsible for beta-catenin stabilization in dorsal organizer formation. The molecular mechanism by which Hwa induces WNT-independent beta-catenin stabilization remains elusive. In this study, we demonstrate that the conserved PPNSP motif of Hwa is phosphorylated by GSK3 and that the phosphorylated PPNSP motif potently inhibits GSK3, leading to beta-catenin stabilization. Notably, the phosphorylated PPNSP motif of Hwa has stronger GSK3 inhibitory activity than the phosphorylated PPPSP motif of LRP6. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that the PPNpSP peptide has stronger affinity for GSK3 than the PPPpSP peptide, facilitated by the hydrogen bonding capacity of the asparagine residue. Consistent with Hwa's GSK3 inhibitory activity, Hwa enhances SIAH1-dependent degradation of AXIN. Hwa-induced beta-catenin stabilization and AXIN degradation are significantly enhanced by oligomerization. Thus, Hwa stabilizes beta-catenin through a molecular mechanism similar to that of LRP6 in mediating WNT signaling, representing a striking example of molecular convergence.
abstract_zh: 胚胎背侧β-catenin的稳定对于背侧组织者的形成至关重要。新发现的跨膜蛋白Huluwa (Hwa) 最近被鉴定为母源背侧决定因子，负责在背侧组织者形成中稳定β-catenin。Hwa诱导不依赖WNT的β-catenin稳定的分子机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们证明Hwa的保守PPNSP基序被GSK3磷酸化，且磷酸化的PPNSP基序有效抑制GSK3，从而导致β-catenin稳定。值得注意的是，Hwa的磷酸化PPNSP基序比LRP6的磷酸化PPPSP基序具有更强的GSK3抑制活性。分子动力学模拟表明，PPNpSP肽与GSK3的结合亲和力强于PPPpSP肽，这得益于天冬酰胺残基的氢键形成能力。与Hwa的GSK3抑制活性一致，Hwa增强SIAH1依赖的AXIN降解。Hwa诱导的β-catenin稳定和AXIN降解通过寡聚化显著增强。因此，Hwa通过类似于LRP6介导WNT信号传导的分子机制稳定β-catenin，代表了分子趋同的一个显著实例。
